situation: Record a payment on a Folio
given: folio_lines allowed only charge and reversal
when: a Guest pays at the desk
then: resolved: folio-payments brings payment lines reducing the balance to zero

given: an open Folio with positive balance
when: a staff member holding finance.post_payment posts a payment with method and positive amount
then: the database inserts a payment line with negative amount and reduces the balance

given: an open Folio
when: a caller posts payment with zero or negative amount
then: the module and check constraint refuse non-positive payments

given: an open Folio
when: a caller posts payment with an unrecognised method
then: the check constraint refuses an invalid payment method

given: a closed Folio
when: a caller attempts to post a payment
then: the trigger folio_line_is_postable refuses the insert

given: an open Folio
when: a staff member lacking finance.post_payment posts a payment
then: the insert policy folio_lines_insert_finance refuses the row

given: a Folio in Organization B
when: a staff member of Organization A posts a payment
then: RLS policy hides the Folio and refuses insert

given: an open Folio with a posted payment line
when: a staff member holding finance.reverse_payment reverses the payment
then: the database inserts an exact positive cancellation line and restores balance

given: an open Folio with a posted payment
when: a staff member lacking finance.reverse_payment attempts to reverse it
then: the insert policy refuses the reversal line

given: a payment line that has already been reversed
when: a caller attempts to reverse the same payment line again
then: unique index on reverses_line_id refuses the second reversal

given: a reversal line on a Folio
when: a caller attempts to reverse the reversal line
then: the database trigger refuses reversing a reversal line

given: a Folio whose payments equal its charges exactly
when: closeSettledFolioWithin is called
then: the Folio is closed with status closed and closed_at timestamp

given: a payment posted to a Folio
when: postPaymentWithin completes
then: an audit record folio.payment_posted is written with method and amount

given: a payment reversed on a Folio
when: reverseLine completes on a payment
then: an audit record folio.payment_reversed is written

given: a viewer holding finance.post_payment viewing an open Folio with balance
when: the Folio detail drawer opens
then: Record payment button is visible and active

given: an open Folio with 450.00 TRY balance
when: the Record payment dialog opens
then: the amount field defaults to 450.00

given: an in-house Guest with 1200.00 TRY charges
when: staff takes 1200.00 payment during check-out
then: the bill confirms zero balance and the Folio closes cleanly without reason

situation: Check-out unpaid leaves balance with reason
given: an in-house Guest with open charges cannot pay now
when: staff confirms check-out and provides reason
then: check-out succeeds leaving Folio open with balance and audit reason recorded

given: an integration with a payment terminal or gateway
when: a payment is processed online
then: deferred: external payment integrations belong to blueprint 5.9 and Phase 5

given: multiple guests sharing charges
when: charges routed across distinct folios
then: deferred: split folios belong to blueprint 5.9
